 "description": "Covers the intersection of robotics, physical therapy, rehabilitation, and movement sciences. Students engage in hands-on projects derived from real-world challenges in collaboration with clinical experts. Follows a systematic design process, from conceptualization to prototype development, emphasizing the application of robotics to enhance therapeutic and rehabilitative outcomes. Key topics include biomechanics, motor control and learning, and sensor integration. Emphasizes collaborative teamwork with peers, faculty, and clinical professionals.
